Casal Bertone — Rome, Italy

In detail

Casal Bertone is a mixed residential and commercial district along Via Prenestina/Via Tiburtina, home to a shopping centre and PEEP-era apartment blocks near the old rail yards. Local press has reported real but scattered problems: a major anti-drug operation involving around 300 carabinieri led to 19 arrests in the area, a couple was arrested with cocaine hidden in metal cases, and drug dealing was uncovered inside a nightclub's bathrooms. In May 2026 an armed robbery hit a jewellery store inside the neighbourhood's shopping centre in broad daylight, and police clashed with far-right activists during the eviction of an occupied building. The combination of documented drug arrests and a daylight armed robbery justifies a cautious yellow rating both day and night.
